hero.sub: Blanc Agency is a boutique premium creative studio based in Kuala Lumpur. We build iconic brand identities, bespoke websites, and viral social media content for TikTok, Instagram & YouTube Shorts — for ambitious brands that refuse to be ordinary. Colour, strategy, and intention — engineered to make people feel something.

services.title: Brand Identity Design
services.desc: Full-spectrum visual identity systems — logo design, typography hierarchies, colour palettes, brand guidelines, and the strategic narrative that ties it all together. We build brands that carry weight.

services.title: Bespoke Web Design & Development
services.desc: High-performance, design-led websites that convert. We combine award-calibre aesthetics with technical precision — no themes, no shortcuts. Every pixel is intentional, every interaction is considered.

services.title: Social Media Content Creation
services.desc: Scroll-stopping short-form content engineered for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. We blend brand strategy with platform-native creativity to build audiences, spark virality, and drive real brand equity.

services.title: Brand Marketing & Strategy
services.desc: We don't just build beautiful things — we make them iconic. Our brand marketing service fuses strategy with social-first precision to grow your brand's presence, authority, and audience across every platform.

about.text1: We exist for the visionary — the founder who knows that design is not decoration, it is differentiation. The creative director who refuses to compromise. The brand that would rather wait for something exceptional than settle for something fast.
about.text2: Blanc Agency is a boutique studio based in Kuala Lumpur, working with select clients globally. Our small, senior team means you get focused expertise, not a junior team running through a process. Every project is treated as the most important one on our roster.

pillars.title: Craft Over Speed
pillars.desc: We take the time required to get it right. Quality is non-negotiable.

pillars.title: Strategy Meets Aesthetics
pillars.desc: Every design decision is grounded in brand strategy and audience insight.

pillars.title: Long-Term Thinking
pillars.desc: We build brand equity that compounds. Not trends that expire.

pillars.title: Radical Transparency
pillars.desc: No surprises. Clear communication, honest timelines, real outcomes.

process.title: Discover & Define
process.desc: We begin with a deep-dive into your brand, market, competitors, and audience. We ask the questions others skip. This phase produces a strategic creative brief that every downstream decision maps to.

process.title: Concept & Create
process.desc: Our senior creatives develop original concepts grounded in strategy. We present two distinct creative directions — not endless iterations — so decisions are clear, considered, and informed.

process.title: Refine & Perfect
process.desc: With a chosen direction, we refine to precision. Copy, colour, spacing, content — every detail is scrutinised. We don't ship work we're not proud of. Period.

process.title: Launch & Scale
process.desc: We deliver production-ready assets, provide onboarding on implementation, and remain available post-launch. For long-term partners, we offer ongoing retainer arrangements.

faq.question: What kind of clients does Blanc Agency work with?
faq.answer: We partner with ambitious founders, established businesses, and creative visionaries who value craft, strategy, and long-term brand equity over cheap, templated solutions. Our clients are typically in lifestyle, tech, hospitality, fashion, and professional services sectors.

faq.question: What is the typical investment for a branding or web project?
faq.answer: Every project is scoped individually to match your ambition. We work in the premium tier — clients who understand that world-class creative is an investment, not an expense. Reach out to discuss your project and receive a tailored proposal.

faq.question: How long does a brand identity or website project take?
faq.answer: A full brand identity project typically takes 4–8 weeks. A bespoke website design and development engagement runs 8–16 weeks depending on scope. We prioritise quality and intention — we don't rush craft.

faq.question: Does Blanc Agency work with international clients?
faq.answer: Yes. While we're based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, we collaborate with clients globally. Our remote workflow is refined and seamless — timezone differences have never been a barrier to producing outstanding work.

faq.question: What makes Blanc Agency different from other creative agencies?
faq.answer: We are a boutique studio — not a production factory. Every project is led by senior creatives, every decision is intentional, and every output is built to endure. We don't do generic. We build iconic.

faq.question: Do you offer ongoing retainer arrangements?
faq.answer: Yes. After an initial project, select clients can engage us on a monthly retainer for continued brand management, content creation, and digital growth support. Retainer relationships are limited to ensure service quality.

contact.desc: Tell us about your vision and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. We work with a select number of clients at any given time — if you're reading this, now is the time to reach out.
